dateEvidence: Three searches. The gov.uk release is retrieved with the raid date given as 14 October ('the release gives the raid date as October 14'), but no excerpt prints the publication date or year. The only indicator is a relative label 'about 18 days old', which from 2026-11-03 would be about 16 October, not 15 October. So 'published: 2026-10-15' in the fragment is NOT confirmed (neither 15 nor 16 Oct can be read).
notes: Figures 12,000 pens, 30,000 packaging, approx £2m, Birmingham industrial unit, MHRA plus West Midlands Police are all supported. Raid 14 Oct stated; release date unverified: either set published to a date confirmed by someone who can read the page, or drop the precise date. Retatrutide statements come from MHRA material but the search did not tie the 'illegal outside clinical trials' wording to this release; reworded to the source's 'could pose serious risks'. No 'safe' wording, no instructions. No sentence claims retatrutide is a GLP-1; fragment drugClasses 'glp-1-receptor-agonists' is unverified by any retrieved text (tirzepatide is not shown as GLP-1 either) and should be dropped or sourced.
